_comment: Crackers category config — TASK-433 category split from bread (Crackers Category Constitution v1, Nutrition Agent, 2026-07-01), expanded TASK-516/517 (2026-07-05) to fold in a ricecakes/פריכיות pool per the Constitution's Rule-5 boundary test. Corpus is now TWO parallel BSIP1/BSIP2 run pairs combined at frontend-packaging time: (1) run_crackers_conform_001 — 21 candidates from real_bread_retail_003_v1 carrying literal 'קרקר' identity, 1 discarded (barcode 5317200, total blackout), 20 scored, 19 displayed (barcode 7290112968807 separately discarded post-rescore, insufficient_data, TASK-433 frontend discard) plus 6 legacy barcodes physically stored in this same directory pre-dating the bread/crackers split (all confirmed router category='cracker', see EV-104 RT-1 resolution — no gap, all correctly scored). (2) run_ricecakes_conform_001 — 36 candidates scraped fresh, 2 discarded (7296058000519 total blackout, 7296058000526 partial blackout/no ingredients), 34 scored and displayed. Combined: 54 scored, 53 displayed. Copy fields (insightLine, rowVerdict, expansion.comparisonContext/positiveSignals/limitingFactors) are AUTHORED for all 53 (TASK-517, two-gate signed off: Content Agent + Adversarial QA) — no longer PENDING_COPY. Scoring: EV-104 (2026-07-05) added PROTEIN_SCALE_TABLES['cracker'] (was falling back to 'default'), D7 co-signed (Product Agent) + Adversarial QA Condition-5 sign-off; 13/53 products moved one letter grade (8 B->A, 3 C->B, 2 D->C), 0 double jumps. Flag set unchanged from the original crackers invocation (grain/non-dairy vector, RECAL_P0=on, FAT_TECH=on, no shelf-rel). Category routing: router_v2.classify_category routes both 'קרקר'-named products AND 'פריכיות'-named products to category='cracker' (HARD_ANCHORS, confirmed live) — both pools share PROTEIN_SCALE_TABLES['cracker'] and CALORIE_DENSITY_TABLES['cracker'] automatically via cd_table_key=category. Known non-blocking gap: the 34 ricecakes products have no _website_cluster value (the existing wheat/spelt/rye taxonomy has no rice axis) — they render in the default view but not under shelf-filter chips until a rice-appropriate cluster is defined.
